text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is a dirt racing feature, so I accompanied
Wonder Acute and the other two for their interview, but—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Tarumae is taking a while~.
She was only supposed to change clothes, so what happened?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm not worried. Why don't we go check on them?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry!
It took me a while to change.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've been so nervous since last night
that I forgot to groom my tail...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, I rushed to brush it,
but it's not looking neat at all...!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, calm down now.
Everything's fine. Come on, breathe in... and breathe out...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you're worried about your tail, I've got something nice for you.
Now, let's see, it should be in my bag—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Try using this.
It'll turn glossy in no time.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's a beeswax cream made from camellia oil and beeswax.
I just happened to bring some along to give to you two.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"If you use that, your hair and tail will turn glossy and smooth.
Now, take your time and comb it out."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What should I do?!
The hem of my racing outfit is unraveling...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The other day, I walked through the bushes to avoid an inauspicious direction, so it must have been then...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright, come over here. Let's get you patched up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This stitching will be easy to undo later,
so please send it in for alterations once the interview is over.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ugh, thank you, Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? ...Wait, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my, it's quite lively today, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry for shouting suddenly!
My pen ran out of ink... and I don't have a spare.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so ashamed of being underprepared.
It's my first time being entrusted with an interview on my own...
I'm truly, truly sorry!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine~, no need to apologize so much.
Was it that the pen ran out of ink?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: At times like that, it helps to warm it up in your hands a bit and then test it out on a tissue~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Because tissue paper is rough,
ink flows out more easily than on regular paper.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it came out!
Thank you so much, you saved me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With Wonder Acute's help, the tense demeanor of the three of them gradually softens—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufu, really? But you know, even I wasn't like this from the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'm much more easygoing than others,
so I've made way more mistakes, too, y'know."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But by piling up experiences of failure like that,
you learn how to handle each situation, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Looking calm right now is just
the result of a whole bunch of things piling up—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: In other words, everything's a learning experience. Accumulating experience is what matters most, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "She says it as if it's obvious, but turning experience into fuel is only possible because of her determination to grow."
choice_data_list: That was a great follow-up, wasn't it?
Did today's interview turn out to be a good experience?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "She says it as if it's obvious, but turning experience into fuel is only possible because of her determination to grow."
choice_data_list: That was a great follow-up, wasn't it?
Did today's interview turn out to be a good experience?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well, that's a relief.
I was worried I was meddlin' too much~

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all! More importantly, there's
one more thing I'd like to consult you about...!"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, yes. If there's anything I can do,
feel free to ask anytime."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Then if you don't mind!
It's just a sudden thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, a formal request arrived
asking for an occasional magazine column called
"Ask Wonder Acute: Wisdom for Everyday Life."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's true... We're truly grateful
to be given so many different experiences.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
I'm all ready!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "I'm good to go too! My racing outfit is flawless☆"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...Looks like those kids aren't
nervous anymore either. That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps influenced by Wonder Acute's gentle presence after that, the interview proceeded in a warm, peaceful atmosphere.
